text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- The annual Old Town Days festival started in Tallinn on Saturday.

- The Baltic defense ministers will attempt to convince Norway to support their NATO bids at the Baltic-Nordic defense ministers' meeting on the Estonian island of Saaremaa on Monday. Norway's statements on the issue have been cautiously worded to date,
- The Council of Europe in the autumn may discuss the first human rights complaints which have been leveled against Estonia.
- The government will not consider the devaluation of the kroon as the Food and Agriculture Organisation recommended in a recent report, Agriculture Minister Andres Varik said.
- Rakvere meat plant says that press allegations that insider trading boosted its share price a few weeks ago are groundless.
- The transport ministry has proposed measures to increase the national airline's share capital and to write off a loan granted last year.
